note: LOOM case-cover system v3 — the WOOL direction, locked to each client's REAL brand colour (sampled from their existing cover). v1 (plain product still-life, no brand colour) was rejected as generic on 2026-08-11: shuffled, you couldn't match a cover back to its client. Here the silhouette is the client's signature product and the ground is their own palette, so recognition comes from product + colour, not from faking a trademark.
style: Hand-crafted textile still-life: every object is sculpted from hand-spun wool yarn, felted wool and hand-woven fabric, with visible knit stitches, macrame cording and a soft halo of loose fibres. Warm low sunlight rakes in from the left, one long soft shadow falls to the right. 85mm macro, shallow depth of field, luminous grade, fine film grain, photographed as a real physical object on a studio table, never an illustration or a 3D render. Subject centred with generous empty space on all four sides, nothing touching the frame edge. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no readable labels, no watermark, no people, no hands.

cases.ellie: A knitted kraft-tan pet-treat pouch standing upright with a simple circular emblem of a dog's head knitted into its face, a felted wool plush bone and a woven collar with a small brass tag in front of it, on a seamless pale lilac-grey paper set.
cases.maison: A tall faceted perfume flacon wound in charcoal-black yarn with a heavy felted honey-gold cap, ribbons of gold yarn curling up around it like liquid gold, on a seamless near-black set with warm gold rim light.
cases.evorahome: A miniature lounge armchair upholstered in chunky cream and oat knitted wool with felted cushions, a slim brass-toned yarn floor lamp arcing behind it, on a seamless warm sand paper set.
cases.boccapiena: A crocheted waffle cone holding three felted wool scoops in pistachio green, strawberry pink and cream, one scoop slumping, on a seamless candy-pink set with a soft magenta neon glow behind.
cases.auraa: Two perfume flacons wound in honey-gold and rose yarn standing on deep wine-red felted velvet, felted roses and yarn petals scattered around them, dark burgundy ground, jewel-toned and opulent.
cases.scion: Four bottle silhouettes of different shapes lined up in a row, each wound in black yarn with honey-gold felted caps, warm amber sidelight raking across the fibres, near-black seamless set.
cases.weitnauer: A modernist building facade woven flat as a precise wall tapestry in cool concrete greys, a single cobalt-blue felted panel set into it carrying an abstract folded-triangle motif, crisp Swiss grid of warp and weft.
cases.slatko: A layered cake built from felted wool discs beside a coiled crocheted pastry spiral, deep pillar-box red and cream yarn, loose crumbs of yarn on the paper, seamless red set.
cases.herbas: Three cosmetics jars felted in soft wool with woven wooden-toned lids, twisted-yarn botanical sprigs and a felted citrus slice beside them, honey-gold and warm grey palette, pale grey seamless set.
cases.place87: A tiny bistro table and espresso cup crocheted in wool with a folded knitted napkin, brass-toned yarn detailing, warm greige and taupe palette, soft window light.
cases.modulart: Stacked modular cubes woven in pale concrete-grey wool, offset and cantilevered like an architectural maquette, one single acid-green yarn band running through the stack, charcoal seamless set.
cases.shteq: Broad woven strapping bands in electric cobalt blue and black crossing over each other in a bold diagonal lattice above a felted white ground, tightly wound edges, hard directional sunlight and crisp shadows.
cases.zen2fit: A rolled hand-woven yoga mat standing upright, a pair of felted wool dumbbells and a coiled macrame cord at its base, warm terracotta and clay palette, soft studio daylight.
cases.bezdrob: A knitted notebook lying open on blank felted pages, a crocheted stopwatch and a coiled woven measuring tape beside it, olive and lime-yellow yarn, seamless olive set.
cases.benetton: A neat stack of folded knitwear in bright saturated colours, cobalt, magenta, honey gold, scarlet and white, crisp folded edges and one sleeve trailing off the stack, on a vivid grass-green seamless set.
cases.ojar: A perfume flacon wound in copper and amber yarn, chunks of felted resin and twisted-yarn dried rose petals scattered around it, a shallow woven copper dish, warm amber and cream palette, sunlit.
